source: IPEDS 2023 collection, NCES Data Center complete data files (HD2023, EFFY2023, GR2023, EF2023D, ADM2023, C2023_A); revised (_RV) files where published
scope: Illinois public and private not-for-profit four-year, degree-granting, Title IV institutions active in the 2023-24 collection

notes.graduation: Bachelor's-seeking subcohort entering fall 2017 (GR2023, GRTYPE 8/12/13/14/15/16); rates are completers ÷ adjusted cohort
notes.retention: Fall 2022 cohort retained to fall 2023 (EF2023D); student-to-faculty ratio as reported
notes.admissions: Fall 2023 applicants, admits and enrolled (ADM2023); test scores are 25th/75th percentiles of enrolled students who submitted
notes.completions: Degrees conferred July 2022–June 2023 (C2023_A), first major, by CIP 2-digit family
